values.note: Water + 20/30 A $40, water + 50 A $50 a night; 20 A small pop-up/tent $35 and tent/no-hookup $30. Up to 4 people per site, $5 a night for each extra person. Weekly and 5-night (Sun-Thu) rates; monthly $675-750 plus electric.

values.note: Reserve with the park's online form or by phone, (607) 522-5200 (office 9-8 in season; online form only off-season). $10 non-refundable deposit, applied to the stay; balance at check-in. Weekends in July and August need both Friday and Saturday; holiday weekends 3 nights. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am; one hard-sided unit per RV site.
